summary.title: Branch Prediction and the Performance of Interpreters
summary.one_liner: Current branch predictors absorb most of an interpreter's dispatch cost, so removing a branch should be measured rather than assumed to help.
takeaways: Modern branch predictors often handle interpreter dispatch branches well, reducing the expected benefit of removing them.
Assuming a branch removal speeds up an interpreter is risky; the change should be measured.
